title: The Ezafe Construction (-e)
summary: Connecting nouns to adjectives or possessors in Persian.
explanation: Ezafe is a short vowel (-e) used to connect nouns to adjectives or possessors.

example_translations.ex_ezafe_1: Ali's book is on the table.

common_error_explanations.err_ezafe_1: Pronounce or write the Ezafe vowel (-e) when linking words.
